NULL AS FIRST_ATTACHMENT_NAME, NULL AS PREVIEW_IMAGE_FILE_ID, CASE WHEN n.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS OWNED_BY_ME, CASE WHEN pin.NOTE_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS n.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} THEN 1 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_SHARES cs_edit WHERE cs_edit.CONTENT_TYPE = 'NOTE' AND cs_edit.CONTENT_ID = n.NOTE_ID AND cs_edit.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y'

AND NVL(n.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND n.DELETED_BY = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
AND NVL(n.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NOTE_PINS p_filter WHERE p_filter.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND p_filter.NOTE_ID = n.NOTE_ID AND p_filter.PIN_SCOPE_KEY = 'NOTE:' || #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
AND n.FOLDER_ID IS NULL
AND n.FOLDER_ID = #{folderId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
AND UPPER(n.NOTE_TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
ORDER BY NVL(n.UPD_DT, n.REG_DT) DESC, n.NOTE_ID DESC ) ordered_notes WHERE ROWNUM <= NVL(#{endRow, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 50) ) WHERE RN > NVL(#{startRow, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0)

UPDATE NOTES n SET n.ORIGINAL_FOLDER_ID = n.FOLDER_ID, n.FOLDER_ID = NULL, n.DELETED_YN = 'Y', n.DELETED_AT = SYSDATE, n.DELETED_BY = #{userId}, n.UPD_DT = SYSDATE, n.UPDATED_BY = #{userId} WHERE n.NOTE_ID = #{noteId} AND NVL(n.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND ( n.USER_ID = #{userId} OR (n.SCOPE_TYPE = 'WS' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w WHERE w.WS_ID=n.WS_ID AND w.OWNER_ID=#{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wm WHERE wm.WS_ID=n.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=#{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(wm.WS_ROLE,'MEMBER'))='ADMIN') )) OR (n.SCOPE_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS p WHERE p.PROJ_ID=n.PROJ_ID AND p.LEADER_ID=#{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID=n.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=#{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(pm.PROJ_ROLE,'MEMBER'))='ADMIN') )) )
